title: Code the approved mobile picks as routed variant pages (session page B, day list, task detail)
brief: Approved by vscode-mastermind 2026-10-22: picks in /framework/ai/sessions/doc/mobile-cards.md (wrapper card, flat rows one indent, day grouped by what needs you, session page B with Overview/Tasks/Chat, bar rules amber/red, light grey ground). Code as real routed pages the owner taps through on the phone, design process: design > review shots > pick > code as <page>/v/<name>/. Real session data, existing classes (Task/Session views); coordinate with the system architect (scaffolding the session menu). Sonnet builders in worktrees; mastermind reviews shots at 400; bring to ready-to-merge. Fold in Follow-up 2 where it fits (card header styles, swipeable tabs; figma-cards/requirements.md). Estimate ~$15. Owner: mastermind-figma-cards.

log.text: Ask added by vscode-mastermind 2026-10-22: a 4th page, the sessions list nested by parent. A child session (minion or mastermind spawned by another session) sits inside its parent, collapsed with a count, so ~70 flat rows become a few parents; tag the kind (VS Code tab, voice, mastermind, minion). Source: the spawn registry's `parent`; task folders nest by parent. A missing parent link goes to the architect as a request. Plan: the Figma pass is skipped because band D (day grouped) and the flat-rows-one-indent pick already cover it; it is coded straight as a variant.

Spawned minion-mobile-picks (Sonnet, medium, $12 ceiling) in a private worktree C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/mobile-picks (pool was empty, so worktree-up.mjs). One builder builds all four pages (day list, sessions nested by parent, session B, task detail) as /framework/ai/sessions/v/mobile/. Alternative: parallel builders, rejected because each would write the same card, row and bar parts (law 6). The Figma pass for the nested list was skipped: band D and the flat-rows pick already cover it. I review each 400 px shot as it lands.

log.msg: Follow-up 3 folded into the brief (3046316a3) and sent to minion-mobile-picks: a run indicator plus pause/stop on every task row, and a computed queued label. Each button appends a log line with Task.js's existing verbs. Not added: a new 'queued' state; it is computed from an idle child of a running series parent.

log.text: Page 1 (day list, v/mobile/) committed; shot shots/day-400.png. Follow-up 3 (run indicator + pause/stop/start buttons, queued mark, shots/run-indicator-400.png) is folded into pages 3 and 4.

Page 1 re-shot (shots/day-400.png): Done group from landed tasks, bar only for 2+ tasks and full width, crumb 'Session variants > Mobile sessions', cards at 8 px. Page 2 committed: shots/nested-400.png (shown on 2026-09-25 because today's sessions have no parent link in session-tree.json, stale since Oct 8).
page 3 session shot: shots/session-400.png (Overview: open work first, run dots with pause/stop; tabs Overview/Tasks/Chat; committed 109c9397c)
page 4 task shot: shots/task-400.png (status + bar on top, content, subtasks as flat rows, open questions)
run-indicator proof: shots/run-indicator-400.png (running task readmes-page: amber dot with pause and stop buttons)

log.msg: Review of every 400 px shot after the Servex restart: all four pages, the run indicator, and smoke passes on worktree/mobile-picks (5 commits). Three fixes sent to the revived builder: task content cut mid-word, session title padding, and the nested header/default day. Missing parent links: session-tree.json was stale since Oct 8 because --index has no scheduled runner. I re-ran it by hand and asked the system architect, on its process-system log, to give it a home.

log.text: review fixes shipped: re-shot task-400 (whole content, More toggle), session-400 (tight title), nested-400 (today, Day-tab header); report at build/report.md

log.msg: Ready to merge, for the owner: branch worktree/mobile-picks (6 commits, last d5c7fe7cd), unmerged. Reviewed: all shots at 400; nested-400.png now nests Mobile picks under Figma cards (+1 minion), 49 sessions. The earlier 'no parent links' was a stale gitignored index.json copy in the worktree, not code. Diff read: AISessionsPage.route('v') is one line; TaskView.bar becomes static draw_bar with amber running and red waiting/paused segments, so the live site's task bars gain those colours too (the owner's bar rule, one component). Run buttons call the Task's own verbs (start/pause/resume/stop), which write through the task log. Smoke passes. Pages: /framework/ai/sessions/v/mobile/ (day), v/mobile/all/ (nested), a session, a task. Phone: http://10.0.0.135:8137/framework/ai/sessions/v/mobile/ once merged.

Status: all four pages were built, reviewed at 400 and marked ready (d5c7fe7cd); Figma bands H and I accepted. Re-check before landing: the branch now conflicts with michael/dev in TaskView.js and mobile-cards.md, since dev landed 2d4e6486c (Task buttons save the verb through Item.act, TaskView.VERBS and actions()). Merging dev into the branch and switching MobileRun to TaskView.VERBS, task.can and task.act, so there is one set of run buttons, not two.

assign.title: Sessions: phone pages, as the mobile variant
assign.outcome:

- [x] Overview, Tasks and Chat, swipeable, with the session menu: session-400.png
